name: Run handoff confirmed → dispatched→executing
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a — the dispatched→executing trigger, half 2 (the run-entity transition). Fires on the RUN entity (agent.chain.execution.<runID>) when rule 01 has stamped agent.run.handoff there AND the run is still in `dispatched`. Advances the run to `executing` via lifecycle_transition (the firing entity = the run entity, which is what the action transitions).

WHY this matters (ADR-053 §D3): the run must reach `executing` before the dispatch-root coordinator's own terminal event is processed by the MilestoneSubscriber — the D3 zombie guard fails any root that terminates while the run is still `dispatched`. The handoff is confirmed (rule 01 gates on rule.task.spawned), so reaching `executing` here is the correct "work is in flight" transition. The D3 race (handoff-marker → this transition vs the coordinator's LoopCompletedEvent) is the empirical watch-item of Phase 4a (see §D).

PHASE GUARD IS A TOP-LEVEL CONDITION, NOT AN ACTION `when` (Coby review round 2): agent.run.phase==dispatched is a rule condition so the rule is simply not-matching until the edge is legal — the illegal dispatched→X is never attempted (no ErrInvalidTransition ERROR log, no lost transition). The processor re-evaluates every entity-state rule on each KV revision (message_handler.go:245), so even if agent.run.handoff lands at the same instant, the transition fires exactly once when both conditions hold.

on_enter.reason: child task handed off (rule.task.spawned confirmed) — run is now executing

metadata.fires_on: the run entity (agent.chain.execution.<runID>) — ENTITY_STATES c360.> is watched by the rule processor (proven by autoresearch/05 post-3a). lifecycle_transition resolves workflow=agent-run via the explicit field; LookupByEntityID would also resolve it from the EntityIDPattern.
metadata.phase_guard_is_condition: agent.run.phase==dispatched is a TOP-LEVEL CONDITION (not an action `when`) so the invalid edge is never attempted (Coby review round 2). See §G/§G2.
metadata.d3_race_watch_item: Must land before the coordinator-root's LoopCompletedEvent reaches the MilestoneSubscriber's D3 guard, else a healthy run is wrongly failed. Mock journeys (fast coordinator = positive race detector) assert agent.run.phase reaches completed, not failed. Upstream ask if it bites: D3 must not fire on CategoryLoopCompleted (§D).
